tickets.title: Complete policy renewal follow-up checks
tickets.text:
Use this checklist for a policy renewal review:
- Confirm the policy type, carrier, owner, insured party, beneficiary, and renewal notice status.
- Request the current declarations page, premium notice, in-force illustration, or renewal packet as applicable.
- Compare current coverage, deductible, riders, exclusions, and premium changes against prior records.
- Ask whether household, business, debt, dependent, or risk exposure changes may affect coverage needs.
- Note whether the client should consult the insurance agent, attorney, or tax professional before making changes.
- Update the planning file with the reviewed documents and summarize any recommended next action. For Serena and Daniel Pebblefizz, obtain the current Amber Teapot Insurance declarations pages and renewal packet for the homeowners and $2 million umbrella liability package, which are not yet in the planning file, and confirm whether the package includes cyber fraud or identity-theft reimbursement.
tickets.evidence: Serena asked whether the homeowners and umbrella package includes cyber fraud or identity-theft reimbursement. The current Amber Teapot Insurance declarations pages and renewal packet are not yet in the planning file, and the agreed follow-up is due 2024-09-05.
